strings.set.logout.title: Sign out?
strings.set.logout.body: Signing out doesn't change your space or room.
strings.set.name: Nickname
strings.acct.delete.title: Delete your account?
strings.acct.delete.lead: You'll be signed out right away, and this can't be undone.
strings.acct.delete.b1: Your account and profile information are deleted
strings.acct.delete.b2: If you share a space, it ends. Neither of you can open it, and the room, photos and decorations are deleted
strings.acct.delete.b3: Signing up again with the same login won't bring anything back
strings.acct.delete.reauth.title: Please confirm it's you
strings.acct.delete.reauth.fail: We couldn't confirm it's you. Please try again.
strings.acct.delete.offline: You need an internet connection to delete your account
strings.acct.delete.fail.title: Couldn't delete it
strings.acct.delete.fail.body: Nothing was deleted yet. Please try again in a moment.
strings.acct.delete.reauth.body: To protect your account, enter your app password.
strings.acct.delete.reauth.wrong: That password isn't right. Please try again.
strings.acct.delete.reauth.rate: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 10 minutes, or confirm with the way you first signed in.
strings.acct.delete.reauth.apple: For accounts created with Apple, the Apple connection is also removed when you delete.
strings.acct.delete.reauth.forgot.title: Can't remember your password?
strings.acct.delete.reauth.forgot.body: Get a reset email, or confirm by signing in again the way you first did.
strings.set.security.title: Sign-in & security
strings.set.security.pwNote: We only ask for your app password before important actions like deleting your account.
